The '''''Journal of Mathematics and the Arts''''' is a quarterly [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[academic journal]] that deals with relationship between [[mathematics]] and [[the arts]].<ref>{{citation|title=Educational Research: Material Culture and Its Representation|series=Educational Research|volume=8|year=2014|pages=163–178|contribution=Olympification Versus Aesthetization: The Appeal of Mathematics Outside the Classroom|first1=Kathleen|last1=Coessens|first2=Karen|last2=François|first3=Jean Paul|last3=Van Bendegem|publisher=Springer|isbn=978-3-319-03082-1|doi=10.1007/978-3-319-03083-8_11|editor1-first=Paul|editor1-last=Smeyers|editor2-first=Marc|editor2-last=Depaepe|quote=And of course, there is the ''Journal of Mathematics and the Arts'', which is dedicated to the topic.}}</ref>

The journal was established in 2007 and is published by [[Taylor & Francis]]. The [[editor-in-chief]] is [[Mara Alagic]] ([[Wichita State University]], Kansas).
